variable {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsSepClosed k]
variable {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

noncomputable section

section ResidualRepresentative

variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
  [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower k K L]
  [Module.Finite K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]

/-! The product curve instances are the same base-change package used by the
general producer.  `exists_effective_of_h0_pos` does not require the finite
cohomology instances, so this bridge only installs the geometric hypotheses. -/

omit [IsSepClosed k] [Module.Finite K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L] in
theorem exists_effective_residual_degree_genus
    (μ : picEt C (overSpec k K))
    (d : SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) μ)
    (r : SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (C := C) (L := L) μ d) :
    ∃ E : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor,
      0 ≤ E ∧
        Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L E = (d.genusValue : ℤ) ∧
        Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L E =
          Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L (d.W₀ - r.S) := by
  haveI : IsIntegral (relCurve C L) := instIsIntegralBaseChange C L
  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
      (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) :=
    instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange C L
  haveI : QuasiCompact (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) :=
    instQuasiCompactBaseChange C L
  have hpos : 0 < Sheaf.h0
      ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L (d.W₀ - r.S)) := by
    rw [r.h0_one]
    norm_num
  obtain ⟨E, hE, hEc⟩ :=
    exists_effective_of_h0_pos (K := L) (d.W₀ - r.S) hpos
  have hdegResidual : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L (d.W₀ - r.S) =
      (d.genusValue : ℤ) := by
    rw [Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_sub' L, d.hdeg, r.degree]
    ring
  exact ⟨E, hE,
    (deg_eq_deg_of_picClass_eq (K := L) hEc).trans hdegResidual,
    hEc⟩

/-! The general consumer keeps the finite separable extension and the exact
input class in scope, and adds the effective degree-genus representative to
the already landed translated-drop result. -/

theorem exists_sepClosedTranslatedDropEffective_general
    (μ : picEt C (overSpec k K)) :
    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra k L) (_ : Algebra K L)
        (_ : IsScalarTower k K L) (_ : Module.Finite K L)
        (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable K L)
        (d : SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) μ)
        (r : SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (C := C) (L := L) μ d)
        (E : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor),
      0 ≤ E ∧
        Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L E = (d.genusValue : ℤ) ∧
        Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L E =
          Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L (d.W₀ - r.S) ∧
        IsSplitWitness C
          (μ * thetaFamily C (chartTwistClass C d.m r.Z) (overSpec k K)) := by
  obtain ⟨L, hLfield, hkL, hKL, htow, hfin, hsep, d, ⟨r⟩⟩ :=
    exists_sepClosedTranslatedDropResult_general (C := C) μ
  letI := hLfield
  letI := hkL
  letI := hKL
  letI := htow
  letI := hfin
  letI := hsep
  obtain ⟨E, hE, hEdeg, hEclass⟩ :=
    exists_effective_residual_degree_genus μ d r
  exact ⟨L, hLfield, hkL, hKL, htow, hfin, hsep, d, r, E,
    hE, hEdeg, hEclass, r.translated⟩

end ResidualRepresentative

end

end AlgebraicGeometry

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
variable {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

noncomputable section

section Compatibility

variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K] [Field L] [Algebra k L]
  [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower k K L]

/-- For a degree-zero input, the base-field class which translates the input into the
rank-one layer has degree `genus C`.

The proof reads the degree of the exact translated class at the identity field point, then
separates its two factors.  The input contributes zero by `mu.2`, while the base-field factor
contributes its `classDeg` by `degAt_thetaFamily`. -/
theorem SepClosedTranslatedDropResult.translator_classDeg_of_pic0
    (mu : pic0Subgroup C (overSpec k K))
    (d : SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) mu.1)
    (r : SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (C := C) (L := L) mu.1 d) :
    classDeg k (chartTwistClass C d.m r.Z) = (genus C : Int) := by
  have hdegree :=
    (r.rankOneLayer mu.1 d).2 K (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id (overSpec k K))
  rw [SepClosedTranslatedDropResult.rankOneLayer_coe, degAt_mul,
    mu.2 K (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id (overSpec k K)),
    degAt_thetaFamily, zero_add] at hdegree
  exact hdegree

/-- The support of the exact divisor passed to `baseSubtraction` is finite.  This is the
finiteness carried by the underlying `Finsupp`, exposed in the point type used by the residue
calculation. -/
theorem SepClosedTranslatedDropResult.subtraction_support_finite
    (mu : picEt C (overSpec k K))
    (d : SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) mu)
    (r : SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (C := C) (L := L) mu d) :
    Set.Finite (r.S.support : Set {x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left //
      x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left}) :=
  r.S.support.finite_toSet

/-- Every point in the finite support of the exact subtraction divisor has residue degree one.
The proof composes the result's support certificate with the datum's section-derived
`hPdeg`; no independent residue witness is selected. -/
theorem SepClosedTranslatedDropResult.residueDeg_one_of_mem_subtraction_support
    (mu : picEt C (overSpec k K))
    (d : SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) mu)
    (r : SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (C := C) (L := L) mu d)
    (p : {x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left //
      x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left})
    (hp : p ∈ r.S.support) :
    (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.residueDeg L p.1 = 1 := by
  apply d.hPdeg p.1
  apply r.support p.1 p.2
  exact Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hp

/-- The finite-support, residue-one, and descended base-class statements for the same
subtraction divisor chosen by the translated-drop theorem. -/
theorem SepClosedTranslatedDropResult.baseSubtraction_compatibility
    (mu : picEt C (overSpec k K))
    (d : SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) mu)
    (r : SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (C := C) (L := L) mu d) :
    Set.Finite (r.S.support : Set {x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left //
        x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left}) ∧
      (∀ p : {x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left //
          x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left},
        p ∈ r.S.support → (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.residueDeg L p.1 = 1) ∧
      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L r.S =
        Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
          ((chartTwistClass C 0 r.Z)⁻¹) := by
  exact ⟨r.subtraction_support_finite mu d,
    fun p hp => r.residueDeg_one_of_mem_subtraction_support mu d p hp,
    r.baseClass⟩

end Compatibility

section PicZeroProducer

variable [IsSepClosed k]
variable {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]

/-- The general per-field translated rank-one producer in the `Pic^0` indexing required by the
separably closed cover.

The output is the existing lambda-tied data/result pair.  Its first conclusion says that the
base-field translator has degree `genus C`; its second conclusion makes the precise
finite-support/residue-one/base-subtraction compatibility available; and its last conclusion is
the existing rank-one-layer `IsSplitWitness`.  Thus this is a specialization and immediate
consumer of the general producer, not a fieldwise replacement for `PicRankOneOpen`. -/
theorem exists_sepClosedTranslatedRankOneLayer_pic0
    (mu : pic0Subgroup C (overSpec k K)) :
    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra k L) (_ : Algebra K L)
        (_ : IsScalarTower k K L) (_ : Module.Finite K L)
        (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable K L)
        (d : SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) mu.1)
        (r : SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (C := C) (L := L) mu.1 d),
      classDeg k (chartTwistClass C d.m r.Z) = (genus C : Int) ∧
        (Set.Finite (r.S.support : Set {x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left //
            x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left}) ∧
          (∀ p : {x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left //
              x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left},
            p ∈ r.S.support →
              (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.residueDeg L p.1 = 1) ∧
          Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L r.S =
            Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
              ((chartTwistClass C 0 r.Z)⁻¹)) ∧
        IsSplitWitness C (r.rankOneLayer mu.1 d).1 := by
  obtain ⟨L, hLfield, hkL, hKL, htow, hfin, hsep, d, r, hsplit⟩ :=
    exists_sepClosedTranslatedRankOneLayer_general (C := C) mu.1
  letI := hLfield
  letI := hkL
  letI := hKL
  letI := htow
  letI := hfin
  letI := hsep
  exact ⟨L, hLfield, hkL, hKL, htow, hfin, hsep, d, r,
    r.translator_classDeg_of_pic0 mu d,
    r.baseSubtraction_compatibility mu.1 d,
    hsplit⟩

end PicZeroProducer

end

end AlgebraicGeometry

          "body": "**Re-kinded `memory` \u2192 `protection` (janitor hygiene pass, run 0048). The body is unchanged.**\n\nRationale: the run-0008 state snapshot in the opening paragraphs is history (C-0001 already re-verified it at HEAD \u2014 `FGAPicRepresentability.lean` now carries exactly one `sorry`, the conditional `instHasPicScheme`). What is still load-bearing is *not* a durable fact but two standing constraints:\n\n1. **Do not close `picardJacobianWitness` directly** (`Jacobian.lean:185`): it is unconditional, while route (b) builds `PicScheme` only for a curve with a rational point. A genus-$\\ge 1$ curve without one needs Galois/\u00e9tale descent from a finite extension where it acquires a point, or a pointed restatement of the north star.\n2. **Do not reintroduce a global `instHasSmoothProperQuotient`, and do not try to prove `smoothProperQuotient` as stated**: Mathlib v4.31 has no quasi-projectivity vocabulary, so hypothesis (2) of Kleiman lm:qt is missing and the statement is false as written (Hironaka-type free $\\mathbb{Z}/2$ action on a smooth proper non-projective threefold). The class is a use-site hypothesis only.\n\nBoth read as a soft freeze, so the item now renders in the Protected section \u2014 more visible to every run, and no longer competing for the ten-item memory budget with the live DD-R certificate memories. Revert with `inbox edit I-0074 --kind memory` if a human prefers it as memory."

      "body": "[persistent] [persistent] REPRESENTABILITY PUSH, 2026-07-29 \u2014 the claim/lane protocol that makes 10 free-objective lanes not collide.\n\nWHY THIS EXISTS. This round replaces prescriptive per-leaf tasks with FIVE lanes per project: one REVIEWER and four PROVERS ranked p1..p4. The provers each pick their own target. That only works if claiming is explicit and public. This item is the claiming mechanism. Read it before your first edit.\n\nTHE FIVE LANES PER PROJECT\n- `review-ajc` / `review-ajcr` \u2014 reviewer. Read-mostly. Finds defects of ROUTE and ORGANISATION, not of individual proofs; may propose refactors and file tasks-as-proposals for the provers. Does not race provers for proof work.\n- `ajc-p1` / `ajcr-p1` \u2014 takes the MOST important open representability item.\n- `-p2`, `-p3`, `-p4` \u2014 2nd, 3rd, 4th most important, where \"important\" is measured against the project's representability headline, not by ease.\n\nCLAIMING \u2014 do this BEFORE you start proving, not after.\n 1. `horizon roadmap list --focus <your project's w4-rep / picrep subtree>` and read the reviewer's open notes.\n 2. Pick your item. Check no other lane owns it: an item with `--owner` set to another lane IS CLAIMED. Do not take it, even if you think you would be faster.\n 3. Claim it: `horizon roadmap set <id> --owner <your-task-id> --status active`. If your target is not yet a roadmap item, `roadmap add` it under the right parent first, then claim it.\n 4. Announce: one `horizon inbox add --kind info --to horizon --body \"CLAIM <lane>: <roadmap id> \u2014 <one line on what discharging it buys>\"`.\n 5. Release on exit: if you did NOT finish, `roadmap set <id> --owner ''` and leave a one-line inbox note saying where you stopped and what the next lane should NOT re-derive. An item left owned by a dead lane is worse than an unclaimed one.\n\nRANK IS A TIE-BREAK, NOT A FENCE. If p1's item turns out to be blocked on p3's, say so in the inbox and swap \u2014 rank exists so four lanes do not all converge on the same top item, not to stop you working on the right thing. p1 has first refusal on any contested item.\n\nYOU MAY PROPOSE WORK TO THE OTHER LANES. Direct-message with `horizon inbox add --kind hint --to task:<lane-id> --body \"\u2026\"`. A good proposal names the declaration, the file, and why it is worth more than what that lane currently holds. You may NOT reassign another lane's claimed item, and you may NOT create new horizon runs or tasks for teams outside your own (`horizon permissions` is false on both counts \u2014 propose to the human instead).\n\nSTANDING BINDING DECISIONS you must not relitigate: `I-0491` (AJC: no rational-point binder on the headline; `hasRationalPoint_of_curve` is FALSE and must be deleted, never proved) and `I-0492` (AJCR: `DivFamZar` widens to arbitrary affine opens; do NOT build the GL_2/Aut(P1) route). Read both.\n\nWHAT COUNTS AS PROGRESS, given the 2026-07-29 audit. That audit found 99 of 101 sampled representability claims refuted: 67 sorry-reachable, 17 VACUOUS, 12 hypothesis-shifted. So the bar is explicit:\n- A discharged obligation must be sorry-free AND its hypotheses must be inhabitable. Before you claim a gate closed, exhibit a witness for every antecedent, or say plainly which antecedent is still undischarged.\n- Do NOT add a class, structure field, or hypothesis whose statement does not mention the object it is supposedly about. `HasDivFunctor` is the cautionary case: its field asserted only that a presheaf category is nonempty, `C` did not occur, and it was advertised as the existence of the relative divisor functor. That is a vacuity, and it survived because nobody read the statement.\n- Do NOT discharge an obligation by projecting the hypothesis you assumed (`choose_spec.1` of your own binder). That is `P \u2192 P`.\n- A green `lake build` is not evidence a statement is non-vacuous. Check imports are current before believing a `lean_multi_attempt` success.\n\nCOMMIT DISCIPLINE. This is ONE shared ledger branch with 10 writers. Another lane's integrate sweep can commit your half-written file before you have measured it once. Write risky proofs as explicit `sorry` first, measure, then fill. Stage explicit files, never `add -A`.",

   119	/-- The general per-field translated rank-one producer in the `Pic^0` indexing required by the
   120	separably closed cover.
   121	
   122	The output is the existing lambda-tied data/result pair.  Its first conclusion says that the
   123	base-field translator has degree `genus C`; its second conclusion makes the precise
   124	finite-support/residue-one/base-subtraction compatibility available; and its last conclusion is
   125	the existing rank-one-layer `IsSplitWitness`.  Thus this is a specialization and immediate
   126	consumer of the general producer, not a fieldwise replacement for `PicRankOneOpen`. -/
   127	theorem exists_sepClosedTranslatedRankOneLayer_pic0
   128	    (mu : pic0Subgroup C (overSpec k K)) :
   129	    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra k L) (_ : Algebra K L)
   130	        (_ : IsScalarTower k K L) (_ : Module.Finite K L)
   131	        (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable K L)
   132	        (d : SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) mu.1)
   133	        (r : SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (C := C) (L := L) mu.1 d),
   134	      classDeg k (chartTwistClass C d.m r.Z) = (genus C : Int) ∧
   135	        (Set.Finite (r.S.support : Set {x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left //
   136	            x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left}) ∧
   137	          (∀ p : {x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left //
   138	              x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left},
   139	            p ∈ r.S.support →
   140	              (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.residueDeg L p.1 = 1) ∧
   141	          Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L r.S =
   142	            Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
   143	              ((chartTwistClass C 0 r.Z)⁻¹)) ∧
   144	        IsSplitWitness C (r.rankOneLayer mu.1 d).1 := by
   145	  obtain ⟨L, hLfield, hkL, hKL, htow, hfin, hsep, d, r, hsplit⟩ :=
   146	    exists_sepClosedTranslatedRankOneLayer_general (C := C) mu.1
   147	  letI := hLfield

   150	  letI := htow
   151	  letI := hfin
   152	  letI := hsep
   153	  exact ⟨L, hLfield, hkL, hKL, htow, hfin, hsep, d, r,
   154	    r.translator_classDeg_of_pic0 mu d,

    43	/-! ## The native adapter contract -/
    44	
    45	/--
    46	A lambda-tied rank-one presentation whose module is canonically the native module of its
    47	cocycle datum.
    48	
    49	The fields after `datum_class` are exactly the remaining producer obligations.  The line-bundle
    50	certificate is derived from the canonical piece trivializations, so a field-level H⁰/H¹
    51	calculation or an unrelated line bundle cannot be silently substituted for the native
    52	evaluation module.
    53	-/
    54	structure PicRankOneNativePresentation
    55	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)) : Type (u + 1) where
    56	  cover : Algebra.EtaleCover A
    57	  representative : descentClasses C cover
    58	  represents :
    59	    PicEtAff.mk C cover representative = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1
    60	  datum : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C cover.Carrier pi
    61	  datum_class :
    62	    (representative : relPic C (overSpec k cover.Carrier)) =
    63	      relPicMk C (overSpec k cover.Carrier) datum.cechPicClass
    64	  native_pushforward_base_change :
    65	    ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
    66	      (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    67	      (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C cover.Carrier)
    68	      (sq : IsPullback g' f'
    69	        (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) g),
    70	      IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app datum.nativeModule)
    71	  h1_vanishing : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 1)
    72	  h0_finite : Module.Finite cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
    73	  h0_projective : Module.Projective cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
    74	  h0_rank_one :
    75	    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum cover.Carrier,
    76	      Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0) p = 1
    77	
    78	namespace PicRankOneNativePresentation
    79	
    80	variable {pi} {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
    81	
    82	/-- Convert the native adapter contract to the existing local-presentation contract.
    83	
    84	The two native bridge fields are inserted definitionally; all other fields are transported
    85	without weakening or adding hypotheses.
    86	-/
    87	noncomputable def toLocalPresentation
    88	    (P : PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam) :
    89	    PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam :=
    90	  { cover := P.cover
    91	    representative := P.representative
    92	    represents := P.represents
    93	    datum := P.datum
    94	    datum_class := P.datum_class
    95	    module := P.datum.nativeModule
    96	    module_iso := P.datum.nativeModuleKSheafIso
    97	    line_bundle := P.datum.nativeModule_isLineBundle
    98	    native_pushforward_base_change := P.native_pushforward_base_change
    99	    h1_vanishing := P.h1_vanishing
   100	    h0_finite := P.h0_finite
   101	    h0_projective := P.h0_projective
   102	    h0_rank_one := P.h0_rank_one }
   103	
   104	theorem nonempty_localPresentation
   105	    (P : PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam) :
   106	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) :=
   107	  ⟨P.toLocalPresentation⟩
   108	
   109	end PicRankOneNativePresentation

   112	
   113	/--
   114	An arbitrary-affine family of native contracts supplies the existing public rank-one-locus
   115	consumer.  The family is quantified in exactly the same way as
   116	`PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition`; the conversion only canonicalizes the module
   117	choice and does not manufacture any of the remaining geometric certificates.
   118	-/
   119	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_nativePresentations
   120	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   121	    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
   122	    (h : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   123	        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
   124	        Nonempty (PicRankOneNativePresentation pi
   125	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))) :
   126	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T := by
   127	  apply mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations pi
   128	  intro A _ _ t
   129	  obtain ⟨P⟩ := h A t
   130	  exact P.nonempty_localPresentation

    42	Membership means that every affine pullback of the input plus class admits a local presentation
    43	tied to that pullback.  This is the correct logical subfunctor underlying the future open Picard
    44	locus; no openness or representability assertion is part of this definition. -/
    45	def PicRankOneOpen :
    46	    Subfunctor (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) where
    47	  obj T := {lam | ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]

    52	    let F := picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)
    53	    have e : F.map t.op (F.map f lam) = F.map (t ≫ f.unop).op lam := by
    54	      apply Subtype.ext
    55	      exact (picEtMap_comp C f.unop t lam.1).symm
    56	    rw [e]
    57	    exact hlam A (t ≫ f.unop)

    59	/-! ## The public membership contract -/
    60	
    61	/-- The exact producer predicate for the rank-one locus.
    62	
    63	This is intentionally lambda-tied and quantifies over every affine pullback.  In particular, it
    64	is stronger than a field-fibre `h⁰ = 1`/`H¹ = 0` statement: a producer must supply the complete
    65	`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` structure for the pulled-back class. -/
    66	def PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition
    67	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    68	    (lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) : Prop :=
    69	  ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    70	    (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    71	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    72	      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))
    73	
    74	/-- Unfolded membership in `PicRankOneOpen`, with the presentation tied to the pulled-back
    75	Picard class.  Keeping this predicate named is important for producers in later lanes: a
    76	field-level divisor or chart witness is not a substitute for this arbitrary-affine-pullback
    77	contract. -/
    78	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_iff {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    79	    (lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) :
    80	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T ↔
    81	      ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    82	        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    83	        Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    84	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam)) := by

    88	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations

    90	    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}

   137	structure PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
